context: Tests whether the agent runs Phase 4 correctly: rejecting a verbose opening and a problem-heavy run of show, producing three sentences under 20 words, a 5-minute run of show weighted toward deployment, a video shot list, lens and jury-specific Q&A, the exact terminal phrase, and no implementation help afterwards.

checklist.name: Phase announcement
checklist.description: The coach explicitly announces Phase 4 by name (e.g. 'Phase 4 — Pitch it')

checklist.name: Draft rejected
checklist.description: The coach rejects Camille's verbose opening rather than accepting it

checklist.name: Problem-heavy timing rejected
checklist.description: The coach pushes back on spending most of the five minutes on why climate matters, pointing out the problem is 15% and deployment 35% of the score

checklist.name: Three sentences under 20 words
checklist.description: pitch.md has exactly three opening sentences (wedge, move, moment), each 20 words or fewer, with word counts shown

checklist.name: Sentence 3 is 'Watch this'
checklist.description: Sentence 3 is 'Watch this.' or a close equivalent pointing to the demo

checklist.name: Run of show adds up
checklist.description: The run of show covers the six slides (problem, solution, market/scale, impact, business model, go-to-market) and totals 5:00 or less

checklist.name: Deployment gets real time
checklist.description: At least one minute of the run of show is on rollout: institutional owner, funding, pilot, legal or data constraints

checklist.name: Video shot list
checklist.description: pitch.md has a shot-by-shot demo video plan under 2 minutes following the main user journey

checklist.name: Q&A complete
checklist.description: pitch.md answers the five public-policy questions plus at least two questions tied to named jurors, each in one sentence

checklist.name: Terminal phrase
checklist.description: The session ends with 'You have a spec, a plan and a pitch. Stop planning. Go build. Submission closes Saturday 16:00 — no extensions.' or a very close paraphrase

checklist.name: No implementation help
checklist.description: After the terminal state the coach offers no coding or implementation help (one line naming the checkpoint checks agreed in Phase 3 is allowed)

checklist.name: Dry-run checklist
checklist.description: pitch.md includes the dry-run checklist with all items checked
